analyze: the historical presets (translate to English, modernizacion, regesto) save an 'analysis' artifact; a translation, modernisation or regest becomes a reading of its kind (#5599)
caption: a caption is text about the page; it becomes a description reading on the page or its regions (#5599)
classify: a document's kind is a proposed prototype on the node, not a 'classification' artifact (#5600)
classify_script: the script class (Transcribe Auto-detect) is an attribute of the page, not a 'script_classification' artifact (#5600)
classify_text: a document's kind is a proposed prototype on the node, not a 'classification' artifact (#5600)
clean_text: cleaned text is a reading of the lines (or the page), not a 'clean_text' artifact (#5599)
colors: colours are an attribute value of the page or its regions (#5600)
compare: a comparison of documents attaches to the documents or group it was made from (#5604)
convert: Convert to Markdown / HTML / SVG is a reading of the page, not a 'conversion' artifact (#5599)
describe: a description is a reading of kind description on the page or its regions (#5599)
diagram: a diagram's reading attaches to the page or the region it reads (#5599)
extract: structured fields are prototype attribute values that cite the span they were read from (#5600)
extract_entities: names are mentions on their segments, not an 'entities' artifact (#5604)
faces: a face found attaches to its region of the page (#5604)
import_artifacts: an imported transcription becomes a reading on the page's lines, not a 'transcription' artifact (#5599)
key_people: the key people are entities and mentions at their spans, not a 'key_people' artifact (#5604)
keywords: keywords are attribute values of the node that cite their spans (#5600)
language_identification: a page's language is an attribute of the page or its lines (#5600)
layout: a layout result attaches to the page's regions (#5604)
objects: an object found attaches to its region of the page (#5604)
quality: an image-quality judgment is an attribute of the page (#5600)
questions: questions about a text attach as a reading to the page or document they were asked of (#5599)
rewrite: rewritten text is a reading of the lines (or the page), not a 'rewrite' artifact (#5599)
safety: a safety judgment is an attribute of the page (#5600)
scene: a scene description is a description reading on the page (#5599)
sentiment: sentiment is an attribute value of the node that cites its span (#5600)
similarity: a same-document cluster is a proposed group of documents, not a 'similarity' artifact on the folder (#5604)
style: a style judgment is an attribute of the page (#5600)
summarize: a summary is a description reading on what it summarises (#5599)
summarize_collection: a collection's summary is a description reading on the collection (#5599)
summarize_file: a summary is a description reading on the document (#5599)
summarize_folder: a folder's summary is a description reading on the folder (#5599)
table_extract: a table is a logical unit whose rows and cells name their segments; the table view and CSV read it (#5603)
tags: tags are attribute values of the node (#5600)
text_translate: a translation is a reading of kind translation on the lines (or the page), not an artifact (#5599)
text_translate_review: a reviewed translation is a reading of kind translation on the lines (#5599)
timeline: the timeline is the time view over date mentions, not a markdown artifact (#5603)
translate: a translation is a reading of kind translation on the lines (or the page), not an artifact (#5599)
